flags.note: Arabic بْرَازِيلِي marks sukun on ب (brāzīli) but transliteration is "barāzīli".
Transliteration "mustashfa" (short a); the pronunciation page (p. 24) gives "mustashfā" for the same word.
Arabic feminine/plural مِتْأَخْرِة / مِتْأَخْرِين lack the shadda on خ that the transliteration shows (mitʾakhkhra / mitʾakhkhrīn) and that the masculine مِتْأَخِّر has.
Arabic لِـ is vowelled with kasra (li-) but transliterated "la-".
Arabic الرَّكَض is vowelled with fatha on ك (rakaḍ) but transliterated "ir-rakiḍ".
Arabic is written with ص (ṣ) but transliterated with ẓ ("ẓghīr"); may reflect colloquial voicing or be a typo.

vocabulary.ar: مِش مُرِيح / مِش مُرِيحِة / مِش مُرِيحِين
vocabulary.translit: mish murīḥ / mish murīḥa / mish murīḥīn

flags.note: Arabic جَامِعِة is vowelled with kasra on م (jāmiʿe) but transliteration is "jāmʿa"; the -a ending also differs from the -e/-ِة pattern used elsewhere.
Arabic إِمْتَى is vowelled with kasra (imta) but transliterated "ēmta".
